latest_release.name: Release 8.0.0.CR2
latest_release.body:
# Hibernate ORM 8.0.0.CR2 released

Today, we published a new release of Hibernate ORM 8.0: 8.0.0.CR2.

You can find the full list of 8.0.0.CR2 changes [here](https://hibernate.atlassian.net/issues/?jql=project%20%3D%20HHH%20AND%20fixVersion%20%3D%208.0.0.CR2).

## What's new


* See the [website](https://hibernate.org/orm/releases/8.0) for requirements and compatibilities.
* See the [What's New](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/whats-new/whats-new.html) guide for details about new features and capabilities.
* See the [Migration Guide](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/migration-guide/) for details about migration.


## Conclusion

For additional details, see:

- the [release page](https://hibernate.org/orm/releases/8.0/)
- the [Migration Guide](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/migration-guide/)
- the [Introduction Guide](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/introduction/html_single/)
- the [User Guide](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/userguide/html_single/)
- the [API docs](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/javadocs)

See also the following resources related to supported APIs:

- the [compatibility policy](https://hibernate.org/community/compatibility-policy/)
- the [incubating API report](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/incubating/incubating.txt) (`@Incubating`)
- the [deprecated API report](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/deprecated/deprecated.txt) (`@Deprecated` + `@Remove`)
- the [internal API report](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/8.0/internals/internal.txt) (internal packages, `@Internal`)

Visit the [website](https://hibernate.org/community/) for details on getting in touch with us.
